23702.subject: Mathematics
23702.question_text: Find the value(s) of x for which the expression is undefined: \(\frac{6x - 1}{x^2 + 4x - 5}\)
23702.explanation:
\(\frac{6x - 1}{x^2 + 4x - 5}\)

The expression is undefined when \(x^2 + 4x - 5 = 0\)

\(x^2 + 5x - x - 5 = 0\)

\(x(x + 5) - 1(x + 5) = 0\)

\((x - 1)(x + 5) = 0\)

The expression is undefined when x = 1 or -5.

23734.question_text: In the diagram above. |AB| = 12cm, |AE| = 8cm, |DCl = 9cm and AB||DC. Calculate |EC|

23738.subject: Mathematics
23738.question_text: A water tank of height \(\frac{1}{2}\) m has a square base of side \(1\frac{1}{2}\) m. lf it is filled with water from a water tanker holding 1500 litres, how many litres of water are left in the water tanker? [1000 litres = 1m\(^3\)]
23738.explanation:
Volume of water taken by the tank = \(\frac{3}{2} \times \frac{3}{2} \times \frac{1}{2}\)

= \(\frac{9}{8} m^3\)

= \(\frac{9}{8} \times 1000\)

= 1125 litres

\(\therefore\) Water left = (1500 - 1125) litres

= 375 litres.

23740.subject: Mathematics
23740.question_text:
A cylindrical container, closed at both ends, has a radius of 7cm and height 5cm [Take π = 22/7]

Find the total surface area of the container
23740.explanation:
T.S.A of a cylinder = \(2\pi r^2 + 2\pi rh\)

= \(2\pi r(r + h)\)

= \(2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times (7 + 5)\)

= \(44 \times 12\)

= \(528 cm^2\)

23743.question_text: A hollow sphere has a volume of kcm3 and a surface area of kcm2. Calculate the diameter of the sphere.
23743.explanation:
\(Volume = \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 = k\) ...(i)

\(S.A = 4\pi r^2 = k\) ... (ii)

Divide (i) by (ii),

\(\frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 \div 4\pi r^2 = \frac{k}{k}\)

\(\frac{r}{3} = 1 \implies r = 3cm\)

Diameter = 2 x 3cm = 6cm

If the height of the smaller triangle = h, 

\(\therefore \frac{h}{6} = \frac{h + 12}{12}\)

\(12h = 6h + 72 \implies 6h = 72\)

\(h = 12 cm\)

\(\therefore\) The height of the cone = 12 + 12 = 24 cm

\(r = 22 \div \pi\)
